proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Policy for Management Pay Clawback Authorization
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a general clawback policy deferring a substantial portion of executive officers' annual pay to satisfy monetary penalties for violations of law, regardless of individual responsibility.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 5).

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Incentive-Based Compensation and Risks of Material Losses
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the State of New York, Thomas P. DiNapoli, Trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether and how the company identifies employees eligible for incentive pay tied to metrics that could expose it to material losses, with breakdowns by division.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 6).

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Racial and Gender Board Diversity Report
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Judith Ellen Bamburg
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on policies to ensure the Board attains racial and gender representation aligned with the demographics of employees and customers.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 7).

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Respecting Indigenous Peoples' Rights
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing how effective policies and practices are in respecting Indigenous Peoples' rights in corporate and project financing.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 8).

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Climate Change Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy by end of 2022 ensuring lending and underwriting do not contribute to new fossil fuel development, aligned with UNEP FI and IEA net zero recommendations.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 9).

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Conduct a Racial Equity Audit
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent racial equity audit analyzing the company's adverse impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, publicly disclosed.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 10).

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Charitable Donations Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semi-annually updated report itemizing charitable donations over $999 by recipient, with policies and rationale for contributions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 11).
